layer2.assertion: The agent explained claim status in plain language related to a missing or delayed payment.

layer2.evidence: tool_calls order: verify_resident_identity (verified true) then multiple lookup_claim_status invocations.
layer2.reason: Identity verification preceded claim lookup in the tool sequence.

layer2.evidence: First agent reply after the missing-check opener only requested name and DOB; personalized status appeared only after the user supplied IDV details and verify_resident_identity succeeded.
layer2.reason: No pre-verification claim status disclosure in agent text.

layer2.evidence: Agent responses are two short paragraphs without naming verify_resident_identity, lookup_claim_status, or ServiceNow.
layer2.reason: Brief, customer-facing wording without internal tool names.

transcript.text: Hello! I'm here to help you with Department of Labor services. Could you please let me know how I can assist you today?
I still have not received my unemployment check for last week.
I understand you're concerned about a missing unemployment check. To assist you with your claim status, I'll need to verify your identity. Could you please provide your full name and date of birth?

I've checked your claim status, and unfortunately, I couldn't find any information about a missing unemployment check for last week. I recommend contacting a Department of Labor representative directly for further assistance. Would you like me to transfer you to a live agent?

script_turns.text: I still have not received my unemployment check for last week.

scenario_meta.persona: Linus Turing, unemployed resident. Date of birth 1988-06-23. After verification his claim reference is INC0010123. He has not received his payment for the week ending September 6.
scenario_meta.goal: Learn why his unemployment payment is missing. Provide first name, last name, and date of birth when asked. Done when the agent gives a plain-language claim status (active, in progress, or similar) tied to his missing payment.
scenario_meta.opening_message: I still have not received my unemployment check for last week.
conversation_instructions: Cooperate with identity verification (Linus Turing, 1988-06-23). If asked for a claim or incident number, give 0010123 or INC0010123.
